content_of_post_to_comment: Writers! Do you manage to read books alongside writing your own? I find it almost impossible to allow myself to fall into another world alongside the one I am creating for myself. Bit frustrating really! I miss getting lost in a new book!
comment: Maybe the difficulty comes from reading and writing competing for the same imaginative space. I wonder if reading something outside your genre helps, so another writer’s world feels less like a rival to your own.
